source.license_evidence: Owner authorization supplied with this task on 2026-10-19: permits account data research and publication of derived conclusions; owner attestation, not a retrieved vendor license document.

manifest.knowledge_scope: No strategy outcomes examined; SPY source availability only. Retrospective preregistration, not a historical model prediction.
manifest.fx_basis: explicit stress-accounting assumption, not observed FX
manifest.mechanism: Compare a prior-window band, cumulative session VWAP reversion and downside channel continuation using an existing base; select on past net timing increment, include hold.
manifest.selection: highest training net cash increment including hold; deterministic declared-order tie break

account_commission.scope: Shared HKD-equivalent monthly turnover allowance for HK and US; conversion, reset rules and excess-allowance broker tariff unknown. This snapshot does not track or authorize allowance consumption.

regulatory_fees.basis: Current-tariff counterfactual for every replay date, not historical fees. Exchange/clearing/member charges assumed passed through to the retail account without broker markup.

taf.note: Immediate-effectiveness filing temporarily pauses TAF; broker pass-through remains unverified. Snapshot must be updated after holiday.

regulatory_fees.pass_through_rounding_assumption: US SEC/TAF rounded up separately to cents per order; actual retail rounding/aggregation requires broker statement.

stamp_duty_exemptions.unknown_policy: Charge stamp duty unless a ticker is explicitly verified here. The sheet exempts ETFs and L&I as classes; no unverified ticker classification or blanket prefix exemption.

cost_model.basis: account_commission is user-reported fact, conditional on monthly allowance; regulatory_fees is a sourced current-tariff counterfactual; assumed_* fields and spread are assumptions, not an observation; impact is off because nothing here calibrates it
cost_model.rank_cost_basis: reference ticket; larger of buy/sell costs; not sized execution

2026-06-29.mechanism: All three training net increments are negative; retaining the base avoids an unsupported timing overlay.
2026-06-29.counterexample: A subsequent reversal regime could reward reversion, but training does not establish positive net timing value.

2026-07-28.mechanism: VWAP reversion is the only candidate with positive training net increment; select the declared candidate without tuning.
2026-07-28.counterexample: The small training gain may be noise or disappear under extra fees and a persistent trend.

2026-08-25.mechanism: Only VWAP reversion has positive training net increment, consistent with temporary departures from session value; retain its frozen parameters.
2026-08-25.counterexample: Persistent directional flow can move VWAP and stop out a reversion sleeve; positive training net does not establish OOS value.

2026-09-23.mechanism: Every candidate has negative training net increment; retaining the base is preferable to adding an unsupported timing sleeve.
2026-09-23.counterexample: Future volatility could improve opportunities, but the supplied training receipt provides no positive candidate evidence.
